items.headline: Flood Watch issued July 21 at 1:31PM AKDT until July 23 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 21 at 12:51PM AKDT until July 21 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to around 80 expected, mainly for interior
locations away from the coast.

* WHERE...Annette Island, City of Hyder, and Ketchikan Gateway
Borough.

* WHEN...until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.areas: Ketchikan Gateway Borough; City of Hyder; Annette Island
items.instruction:
Take extra precautions when outside. Wear sunscreen and light loose
fitting clothing. Take action when you see symptoms of heat
exhaustion and heat stroke.

Locations next to the ocean or glaciers will be cooler with a
stronger breeze in the afternoon.
